```
def build_json_report(announcements: List[Dict], vulnerabilities: List[Dict
    ], remediations: Dict[str, Any], packages: List[Any]) ->Dict[str, Any]:
    report = get_report_brief_info(as_dict=True, report_type=1,
        vulnerabilities_found=len([v for v in vulnerabilities if not v.ignored]),
        vulnerabilities_ignored=len([v for v in vulnerabilities if v.ignored]),
        packages_found=len(packages))

    scanned_packages = {}
    for pkg in packages:
        scanned_packages[pkg.name] = pkg

    affected_packages = {}
    for vuln in vulnerabilities:
        if not vuln.ignored and vuln.package_name not in affected_packages:
            affected_packages[vuln.package_name] = vuln.pkg

    active_vulns = [v for v in vulnerabilities if not v.ignored]
    ignored_vulns = [v for v in vulnerabilities if v.ignored]

    remediations_output = {}
    for pkg_name, rem_data in remediations.items():
        pkg_remediations = {}
        for spec, spec_data in rem_data.items():
            pkg_remediations[spec] = spec_data

        remediations_output[pkg_name] = {
            'requirements': pkg_remediations,
            'current_version': None,
            'vulnerabilities_found': None,
            'recommended_version': None,
            'other_recommended_versions': [],
            'more_info_url': None
        }

    template = {
        'report_meta': report,
        'scanned_packages': scanned_packages,
        'affected_packages': affected_packages,
        'announcements': get_basic_announcements(announcements),
        'vulnerabilities': active_vulns,
        'ignored_vulnerabilities': ignored_vulns,
        'remediations': remediations_output,
    }

    return template
```
